capture_run.source_surface: Google Trends web UI API endpoints (explore + widgetdata); two same-day in-page sessions: automation pane (batches b01-b13 morning UTC) and the owner's real Chrome (b06, ~15:00 UTC; see manifest capture_session field)
capture_run.value_semantics: Google Trends 0-100 relative search-interest index, normalized per batch to the batch peak; not counts, sales, demand size, or population rates
capture_run.entity_topic_id_pin: unavailable_by_source: freeform query strings used; no stable topic entity IDs captured
capture_run.pull_date_pin: 2026-08-05 (single one-shot pull; values are not comparable to future pulls without re-anchoring)
capture_run.record_uniqueness: one record per (term, geo, window, batch_id); the anchor term recurs across batches by design and each batch carries its own 0-100 normalization
